subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should OpenClaw standardize hook `HOOK.md` metadata on a direct-regular-file requirement with a 1 MiB maximum across installation and workspace discovery?
rationale: The implementation closes the allocation risk correctly, but the numeric and file-type limits intentionally change the accepted hook package contract and are not established by current documentation.

options.title: Adopt the strict contract
options.body: Approve the 1 MiB direct-regular-file boundary across both hook paths, retaining installation errors and discovery skips.

options.title: Choose another shared boundary
options.body: Revise this PR and the complementary workspace PR to an owner-approved size or file-type policy before merging.

recommendation.title: Adopt the strict contract
recommendation.body: Approve the 1 MiB direct-regular-file boundary across both hook paths, retaining installation errors and discovery skips.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the original and repeated ownership of hook installation and its security boundaries.
